summary: Takeda Pharmaceutical Co Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a financial appendix with non-IFRS measures, reconciliations, and forecasts for FY2025 results and FY2026 guidance. The filing defines core financial measures (Core Revenue, Core Operating Profit, Core Net Profit, Core EPS) and constant exchange rate (CER) changes. This is a routine periodic financial disclosure, not a special situation event. No deal terms, price, premium, or board recommendations are present. The filing is an ordinary earnings update with definitions and reconciliations, lacking any M&A, restructuring, or capital return triggers.
